layout_strategies.general: Embrace negative space and asymmetric bento layouts. Avoid generic centered alignment.
layout_strategies.hero: Full height with subtle parallax image, gradient overlay bg-black/30 for readability. Incorporate a slow organic Marquee component (react-fast-marquee) at the bottom.
layout_strategies.admin: Standard sidebar dashboard utilizing Shadcn components. Sharp, data-dense, functional but themed with brand colors.

component_rules.marketing: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for expressive sections. Avoid Shadcn cards for marketing; use raw divs with soft borders. Keep interactive elements easily identifiable.
component_rules.dashboard: Always use Shadcn components (Table, Input, Button, Dialog) configured with custom CSS variables.
component_rules.motion: framer-motion for page transitions and scroll triggers (staggered fade-ins).

media_urls.description: Warm, rustic bohemian cafe interior at golden hour.
Flat lay of handwritten recipe cards.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.description: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px subtle inner border border-white/40. Logo centered (Cormorant Garamond). Links on sides.

sections.name: Hero Landing
sections.description: Full height. Uses 'hero_background'. Overlay bg-black/40. Large H1 'MARILÓ'. Call to action to view menu. Marquee at bottom (Editorial Ribbon): 'Artisanal Coffee • Fresh Pastries • Bohemian Soul'.

sections.name: Menu / Carta
sections.description: Split asymmetric layout. Not cards. Use raw HTML/Tailwind. Left side: category titles and pure text rows (Item.....Price). Right side: A lifestyle image of coffee (gallery_pastry_1).

sections.name: Tiendita (Store)
sections.description: Horizontal scroll or simple grid of physical items available in store (coffee beans, mugs). Minimalist display with soft shadows, beige background. Label: 'Available in our physical store'.

sections.name: Recipe Shelf (Downloads)
sections.description: Bento grid layout. Background image 'recipe_shelf_background' on main bento item. Overlay with dark/light text. Buttons to download PDF recipes.

sections.name: Gallery & Instagram
sections.description: Masonry grid using all interior and pastry images. Floating central CTA button with an Instagram icon 'Follow @marilocafeteria'.

sections.name: Location & Footer
sections.description: Split screen. Map embed (iframe) on one half, address, hours, and contact on the other half. Warm earthy footer with large 'MARILÓ' logo.

sections.name: Login
sections.description: Simple centered login card. Shadcn Card, Input, Button.

sections.name: Dashboard Shell
sections.description: Sidebar navigation (Menu, Gallery, Tiendita, Recipes). Topbar with logout.

sections.name: Content Management
sections.description: Shadcn Tables for listing items. Shadcn Dialogs for Add/Edit. Forms with Shadcn Inputs/Selects.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text, 3:1 for large text against all backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up Tailwind CSS with the defined color palette and typography. Add font imports to index.css. 2. Develop marketing site using pure HTML/Tailwind and framer-motion for animations. 3. Build Admin panel using Shadcn components (install necessary ones like button, input, card, dialog, table). 4. ALWAYS include the provided data-testids on interactive elements. 5. Use the provided media URLs, NO placeholders. 6. Build in .js/.jsx, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). 7. Include react-fast-marquee and framer-motion.
